teams.heading: Fiji remain bottom of the Nations Championship table after three opening defeats
teams.body: Fiji occupy 12th place in the Nations Championship table after three rounds of competition. The side has yet to record a win in the tournament. They have scored 49 points while conceding 145 across those three matches, leaving the squad with a current points difference of -96. Their most recent fixture resulted in a 33-17 defeat against Scotland. The Flying Fijians previously lost 34-21 to their next opponents, France, when the sides met away from home in November 2025.

teams.heading: Ellie Kildunne and England Women host New Zealand seeking immediate WXV response
teams.body: England Women return to Allianz Stadium today to face New Zealand in their final WXV Global Series encounter of the first window. Following a dramatic draw against Canada that ended a record 39-match winning streak last weekend, the Red Roses are searching for an immediate return to form against the world’s second-ranked side. New Zealand arrive at Twickenham following a 66-point victory over Scotland. Digital coverage is available across BBC platforms for this afternoon's meeting at the home of English rugby.

teams.heading: France demonstrate significant attacking form across their latest eleven matches
teams.body: France have maintained a high-scoring output throughout their recent international campaign. Across their last 11 matches, the side recorded 426 points scored, averaging 38.7 points per game. Their defensive efforts conceded 291 points, an average of 26.5 per fixture, over the same period. This run of form includes the team's most commanding victory of the window, a 54-12 defeat of Wales during the 2026 Six Nations in February.

teams.heading: Ireland Women's Aoife Wafer ruled out of upcoming Japan Test match
teams.body: Ireland Women's back row Aoife Wafer has been ruled out of Sunday’s WXV Global Series encounter against Japan due to a minor injury sustained in training. Head coach Scott Bemand has responded by making 6 changes to his starting XV following last week’s defeat to the USA. Eilís Cahill earns her first start, while uncapped hooker Beth Buttimer is named among the replacements. Bemand noted the match serves as an opportunity to add more layers and attacking prowess to the team’s game.

teams.heading: Wales Women Target Back-To-Back Test Wins Against The USA
teams.body: Sean Lynn's side welcome the USA to Cardiff Arms Park looking to secure consecutive Test victories for the first time in his tenure. Wales enter the fixture following an eight-try display against South Africa that ended a run of nine consecutive defeats, while the Eagles arrive in the Welsh capital having overturned a deficit to defeat Ireland in Dublin. Lleucu George returns to the starting XV at fly-half alongside Carys Cox on the wing, with Georgia Evans set to win her 50th cap.

teams.heading: Johann Van Graan Praises Santiago Carreras Ahead Of Bath Opening Round
teams.body: Bath director of rugby Johann van Graan has credited Santiago Carreras' character as the Argentina full-back returns to club duty for the opening round of the 2026-27 Premiership season. Van Graan revealed that Carreras enjoyed a blistering 20-minute spell in training where he looked like the "best player on the planet". Describing the Argentine international as "jovial" and one of the best team men in the squad, the coach emphasised that the player is fully focused on what lies ahead following his international commitments with Los Pumas earlier in the year.

teams.heading: Herschel Jantjies reveals renewed fire ahead of Springboks Test
teams.body: Springboks scrum-half Herschel Jantjies admitted that his move to Top 14 club Bayonne helped reignite his international ambitions ahead of Sunday's fixture in Perth. Jantjies, who will make his 26th Test appearance and partner Handré Pollard at half-back, noted that being out of the national set-up taught him patience following his absence since the 2023 Rugby World Cup. The 30-year-old stated that working with the coaching group has sparked his hunger for the team once again.
